explanation:
A row-major `M × N` matrix in memory is a column-major `N × M` matrix, its transpose. So ask cuBLAS for `Cᵀ` (`N × M`)
`= Bᵀ (N × K) · Aᵀ (K × M)`: the buffers are already `Bᵀ` and `Aᵀ` in column-major terms. Transposing both inputs
(option three) still produces a column-major `C`, which is the wrong layout for you.
